name: Dux de Pandemonii
source:
The Duke of Pandemonium has 'saved' you from the mundane realm. He's determined to spare you the cruelties he himself has experienced. But something horrific hides behind the doors that lead to the 'Chamber of Adoration', something that would destroy who you are.

But this isn't like any journey to the nightmarish Neverplace that you've had before. In your heart, you know there's no way out.  What now? Will you wait for help to come...or surrender to what some might call fate? 

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/dux-de-pandemonii]itch.io[/url]]
